Why choose Eneco?

At Eneco we work towards one clear goal: being climate-neutral by 2035. A big part of that is flexibility, using renewable energy at the right moment. Our Virtual Power Plant (VPP) links many energy sources and steers them centrally as one portfolio.

More and more of that flexibility sits "behind the meter", at our customers' sites: large batteries, solar panels and other installations. Your services make it possible for these smaller assets to join the market together. That means more green energy used well, and less need for fossil backup. You do this in a team that takes engineering seriously, shares what it learns, and gives you room to grow as a technical leader.

You build and maintain backend services and integrations in .NET/C#.
You develop solutions that optimise behind-the-meter assets and connect data flows so smaller assets can trade as part of Eneco's pool.

You build quality into features from the start, instead of testing them afterwards.
You use AI tools across your work, including test generation, refactoring and debugging, and review the output critically.

You use AI-assisted development tools in your daily work, check their output critically, and like sharing what works with your team.
You're happy to take on-call responsibility, live in the Netherlands and speak English fluently.
Knowledge of energy markets, optimisation or aggregation platforms is a plus. Don't have it yet? You'll learn the domain here.

Reliable, scalable services that connect distributed assets to our VPP and keep running 24/7.

Start your career with the Strategic Student Program (SSP) 

The Strategic Student Program (SSP) is our global internship program at Siemens Digital Industries Software. You will be mentored by experienced professionals, gain practical experience on real customer projects, and work with cutting-edge technologies that support the digital transformation of manufacturing industries.

As an SSP intern, you will join an international student community, access structured learning through the Siemens Learning Hub, receive ongoing coaching, and contribute to meaningful projects within a global and diverse engineering team.

What you'll be doing as part of the Next-Gen Ops Intelligence team in Rotterdam?

A convincing answer is not always the right one. Help an AI operations assistant tell the difference.

You will build on an existing AI-assisted operations prototype for a systems engineering simulation platform, exploring how it can weigh diagnostic evidence, choose useful follow-up checks, and recognize when a software developer or a support/DevOps engineer should take over.

(Note: The project focuses on diagnostic support in controlled scenarios, not autonomous changes to live production services.)

You will contribute to activities such as:

Understand the evidence: Explore how the assistant uses logs, service states, and incident history. Identify missing, outdated, duplicated, or conflicting clues, and connect observations to the right incident and time window.
Choose the next useful check: Prototype ways to weigh evidence and decide whether to reach a conclusion, investigate further, or ask for human input. Make additional checks useful, not just more numerous.
Make conclusions clear: Connect each finding to the evidence behind it. Explain remaining uncertainty and give engineers a useful handover instead of a confident guess.
Test what really improves: Build replayable incident scenarios and compare your approach with the existing assistant. Aim for fewer unsupported diagnoses without simply refusing difficult cases; measure usefulness, investigation cost, and response time.
Integrate and demonstrate: Bring the method into the prototype and show it working end to end. Deliver reusable code, a repeatable evaluation, and an honest account of its strengths and limits.

Job Description:
We are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

You Are

You have spent years testing and verifying embedded software used in complex production systems, where missed corner cases can affect product quality, reliability, and security. You understand that embedded software verification requires a systematic strategy that demonstrates correct behavior across interfaces, operating modes, build variants, and target configurations—not simply the execution of individual tests. You are experienced in designing scalable test environments, automating verification activities, and applying modern build and test frameworks to embedded software.

You are comfortable translating subsystem requirements and software architecture specifications into practical verification strategies and traceable test plans. You can isolate failures across software components, hardware interfaces, build environments, and test infrastructure, and you communicate findings clearly to developers and architects. You understand the challenges of verifying embedded software across multiple product configurations. At Synopsys, you will take the lead in verifying embedded security software that runs on embedded Security IP products, in particular on a programmable Root of Trust security subsystem. As part of an experienced team in Eindhoven, you help to protect devices across automotive, mobile, networking, and IoT applications.

What You'll Be Doing

Define and execute verification strategies for embedded software in complex security subsystems, including firmware, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, libraries, and host-side software.
Develop requirement-based test plans, test specifications, and traceability that cover functional behavior, interfaces, error handling, robustness, performance, and security-relevant scenarios.
Guide a team of verification engineers to efficiently implement and execute the specified test plans.
Build and maintain automated test environments using modern build, test, and continuous integration frameworks.
Verify software across multiple configurations, including processor targets, compiler and build options, enabled features, hardware variants, and deployment environments.
Create and maintain unit, component, integration, subsystem, regression, and hardware-software co-verification tests.
Run tests in simulation, emulation, virtual-platform, FPGA, and target-hardware environments as appropriate.
Analyze test results, logs, traces, and coverage data; distinguish software defects from hardware, configuration, build, and test-infrastructure issues.
Work closely with software developers, hardware designers, system architects, and product teams to root-cause defects and drive them to resolution.
Improve regression efficiency, reproducibility, reporting, and coverage through scripting, tooling, and test-framework development.
Contribute to verification reviews, release readiness assessments, and continuous improvement of software quality processes.
Use AI to optimize and implement efficient workflows.

The Impact You Will Have

Your verification strategies will identify critical product defects before release and increase confidence in embedded security products deployed in production systems.
The scalable test environments you develop will enable consistent verification across multiple subsystem configurations and product variants.
Your automation work will shorten regression cycles, improve reproducibility, and provide faster feedback to development teams.
The test plans, traceability, and coverage measures you establish will define a clear and measurable quality bar for product releases.
Your failure analysis and cross-functional collaboration will reduce debug time and improve the quality of both software and hardware-software interfaces.
Your technical leadership will strengthen verification practices and help the Eindhoven team adopt effective modern build, test, and continuous integration approaches.

What You'll Need

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with 8+ years of hands-on experience in embedded software testing or verification.
Proven experience defining and executing verification strategies for embedded software, firmware, drivers, or complex software subsystems.
Strong programming and scripting skills in languages such as C, C++, Python, or comparable languages used for embedded development and test automation.
Practical knowledge of modern build systems, test frameworks, package or dependency management, and continuous integration pipelines.
Experience effectively deploying AI tools to improve embedded software verification, test automation, and engineering workflows.
Experience managing verification across multiple build variants, target platforms, feature configurations, and hardware or software environments.
Experience with unit, integration, subsystem, regression, and system-level testing, including test automation and results analysis.
Strong understanding of embedded systems, processor architectures, memory-mapped interfaces, device drivers, and hardware-software interaction.
Experience with debugging tools, logs, traces, code coverage, static analysis, and defect-tracking workflows.
Familiarity with simulation, emulation, virtual platforms, FPGA prototypes, or target-hardware test environments is an advantage.
Knowledge of security software, cryptographic algorithms, secure boot, or embedded security is a strong plus.

Who You Are

You can analyze subsystem requirements and software architecture, identify verification risks, and propose a practical, coverage-driven verification strategy.
You develop test code, automation, and verification infrastructure that are maintainable, reusable, and clear to other engineers.
You approach failures methodically, narrowing problems across software, hardware, configuration, and infrastructure boundaries.
You provide constructive technical feedback when requirements, test plans, or coverage need strengthening.
You work effectively across disciplines and time zones, maintaining clear communication and alignment on verification goals.
You stay current with embedded software verification practices, build and test frameworks, automation techniques, and security developments.
You communicate findings clearly, with evidence, root-cause analysis, risk assessment, and a practical path to resolution.

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Security IP group in Eindhoven, a dedicated team advancing embedded security technologies that enable customers to build chips and systems with cutting-edge cryptographic solutions. The team brings together hardware, firmware, software, architecture, and verification expertise to deliver security IP used in advanced automotive, networking, mobile, and IoT applications. You will play a senior role in ensuring that embedded software operates correctly and consistently across complex subsystem configurations and integration environments. This is a global group that takes security and engineering quality seriously and builds products to the Synopsys standard for best-in-class quality.

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Familiar with complex large scale distributed systems.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Zeker van je impact vandaag. Vrij om te bouwen aan morgen.

Bij EY weet je zeker dat je het verschil maakt: voor je klant, de samenleving, je collega én je eigen ontwikkeling. Tegelijk krijg je de vrijheid om te werken op een manier die bij jouw leven past. Of je nu kiest voor verdieping, verbreding of leiderschap: jij hebt de regie. Samen met ambitieuze collega’s in een open en vertrouwde cultuur ga je elke dag voor het hoogst haalbare. Groot in mogelijkheden, vriendelijk in samenwerking. EY zorgt voor de middelen die je nodig hebt je carrière verder vorm te geven en impact te maken binnen jouw vakgebied.

Jouw nieuwe baan | Over je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Bij EY bieden wij je de kans om een andere draai aan je carrière te geven. Wij zoeken mensen die ervaren zijn met risk technologie consultancy and implementaties, maar naar een bredere verantwoordelijkheid willen groeien – van account development tot en met delivery. Vanuit deze positie kan je een brugfunctie vervullen tussen business, risk, en technische stakeholders – en daarmee meer waarde creëren voor jezelf, de klant, en EY.

EY is een platform van waaruit je eigenaarschap kan nemen over (ServiceNow) risk technologie proposities en deze samen met collega’s in de markt kan zetten. Hiermee leer je de vaardigheden om bijvoorbeeld in de toekomst als practice lead te kunnen functioneren.

Als basis van deze transitie zoeken wij collega’s die goed kunnen functioneren als Risk Technology Manager binnen onze Platforms team. De focus binnen dit team ligt op het ServiceNow platform, maar er is ruimte om te werken aan proposities rond bijvoorbeeld Archer, IBM Open Pages en Metricstream. Als Risk Technology Manager speel je een cruciale rol in het leveren van innovatieve oplossingen aan onze klanten. Tot je verantwoordelijkheden behoren:

Vertalen van risk-, compliance- en business requirements naar technische oplossingen.
Op een lijn brengen van mensen, processen en technologie.
Adviseren over migratie van risico en controls (frameworks) naar nieuwe systemen en over benodigde rapportages.
Leiden van (offshore) implementatie teams.
Zorg dragen dat oplossingen volgens ontwerp wordt geïmplementeerd en resultaat voldoet aan business requirements.
Definiëren en uitdragen van best practices op het gebied van implementatie maar ook (agile) way-of-working.
Begeleiden van junior teamleden en bijdragen aan hun ontwikkeling.
Samenwerken met collega's uit Cyber, Risk, Technology Consulting en Business Transformation om geïntegreerde oplossingen voor klanten te realiseren.
Ondersteunen van pre-sales trajecten, offertes en proposities.
Adviseren van klanten over hoe technologie efficiëntie, duurzaamheid en zakelijk succes kan bevorderen.

Naast deze verantwoordelijkheden heb je dus de vrijheid om andere initiatieven te ontwikkelen en je eigen draai te geven aan je carrière.

Jouw nieuwe team | Over je collega’s en het kantoor

Word onderdeel van een team waar jouw ideeën worden gewaardeerd, jouw groei wordt ondersteund en jouw carrière kan floreren. In onze samenwerkingsgerichte en inclusieve werkomgeving bouw je sterke relaties op met klanten en collega’s, zowel in Nederland als internationaal. Wij stimuleren een cultuur waarin leren, ontwikkeling en welzijn hand in hand gaan, omdat we weten dat wanneer jij groeit, onze klanten eveneens groeien.

Ons Platforms-team binnen Technology Consulting helpt organisaties innovatie te omarmen door het ontwerpen en implementeren van transformerende digitale oplossingen. We combineren de nieuwste technologieën met diepgaande sectorkennis en benutten strategische samenwerkingen met toonaangevende technologiepartners. Bij EY geloven we dat diverse perspectieven leiden tot de beste oplossingen en moedigen we iedereen aan om zijn of haar unieke kwaliteiten in te brengen.

Jouw kantoor

Amsterdam

Ons kantoor in Amsterdam bevindt zich op de Zuidas: een bruisende plek waar veel bedrijven zijn gevestigd. In onze Cross Towers worden maar liefst 1500 mensen per dag bij binnenkomst verwelkomd. Voor een adembenemend uitzicht op Amsterdam ga je naar de 22e verdieping. Samenwerken krijgt door de Wavespace een nieuwe betekenis. Deze High-Tech omgeving brengt wereldwijd klanten en collega’s virtueel samen.

Jouw vaardigheden en skills | Over je unieke bijdrage

Een afgeronde bachelor- of masteropleiding.
Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring, waarvan minstens 3 jaar praktische ervaring met risk implementaties (bijvoorbeeld van ServiceNow, Archer, Metricstream).
Minimaal 1 jaar ervaring met ServiceNow implementaties.
ServiceNow gecertificeerd, bij voorkeur op het gebied van SecOps of Risk.
Kennis en ervaring met de financiele sector.
Bij voorkeur kennis en ervaring met DORA, COSO, COBIT, of SOC rapportages.
Kennis van talen zoals bijvoorbeeld Javascript, HTML, en SQL.
Je voelt je comfortabel in klantgesprekken, pre-sales, communicatief en het leiden en begeleiden van implementatie teams.
Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar.

Jouw arbeidsvoorwaarden | Over je voordelen en werkplezier

Een passend salaris voor je rol en verantwoordelijkheid, afhankelijk van ervaring en kwalificaties. Plus, een goed pensioen. Fijn voor later. Bovenop je salaris ontvang je ook vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus (afhankelijk van resultaten en ontwikkeling).
Een laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken en een maandelijkse internetvergoeding.
34 vakantiedagen, om op te laden en bij te tanken + de mogelijkheid om meer dagen te kopen.
Met het mobiliteitsbudget bepaal jij zelf hoe je reist, kies bijvoorbeeld voor een leaseauto, een voordelig OV-abonnement of regel je vervoer eenvoudig via onze app.
Bij EY vinden we een gezonde werk-privé balans belangrijk. Hybride werken maakt dat een stuk makkelijker. Of je nu werkt op kantoor, bij de klanten of thuis; Wij zorgen ervoor dat je een goed ingerichte thuiswerkplek krijgt. 
De mogelijkheid om 20 werkdagen per jaar vanuit het buitenland te werken.
De mogelijkheid om 3 nationale feestdagen om te ruilen voor niet-nationale feestdagen. 
Zowel persoonlijk als professioneel krijg je alle ruimte om te groeien. Of je je nu wilt ontwikkelen in je vak, als persoon of in je leiderschapsstijl, we hebben een uitgebreid aanbod aan trainingen en opleidingen.
Jouw gezondheid staat voorop. Wij geloven dat als je goed in je vel zit, je ook beter presteert. Zo krijg je onder andere toegang tot het wellbeing platform OpenUp (en ook jouw gezin). Je kunt hier laagdrempelig en binnen 36 uur in gesprek gaan met psychologen en lifestyle experts én kun je deelnemen aan sessies op het gebied van wellbeing. 
Veel aandacht voor teaming en verschillende interne netwerken waarmee je aan allerlei sociale activiteiten kunt deelnemen. Een fijne werksfeer en goede samenwerking met collega’s dragen immers ook bij aan jouw werkgeluk.

En dat alles binnen een omgeving waar onze kernwaarden integriteit, inclusiviteit en respect centraal staan. We vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt zijn én je volop kunt ontwikkelen tot de beste versie van jezelf. Benieuwd naar al onze voorwaarden? Klik hier

At Workwize, we're helping IT teams to easily equip their remote and global teams with all necessary IT equipment. Our automated SaaS platform simplifies hardware deployment, management, and retrieval with fast, reliable deliveries in 100+ countries.

Join our team to help shape the future of global collaboration. At Workwize, your work will make a real impact in building smarter, more connected workplaces worldwide.

LinkedIn has also recognized Workwize as one of the Top 10 Startups for 2025 in the Netherlands!

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer you work directly with our most important clients and build what they need on our platform: integrations, workflows and product features that make their IT run itself.

This is a brand new team, set up like a startup inside Workwize. It exists for two reasons. New clients should go live in weeks, not months. And our clients should get an engineer who knows their setup and fixes things fast.

Nobody hands you tasks. There is no product manager writing specs for you. You talk to the client, decide with them what is worth building, build it, ship it, and check with real numbers that it made a difference.

Think of work like this: connecting a client's HRIS (Personio, BambooHR, Workday) so every new hire gets the right laptop on day one, syncing devices with Intune or Jamf, or automating approvals through Okta or Entra ID. To be clear: this is not a machine learning or AI research role. You use AI tools every day to move fast.

How the work runs

Discover. Get deep into the client's IT world: goals, processes, tech environment, governance, and adoption blockers.
Design. Turn that into engineering solutions: what Workwize owns, what integrates, and how it becomes a durable layer that makes IT simple.
Deliver. Stay hands-on through onboarding, building, launching and iterating until it is live and the value is real.

Key Responsibilities

Lead discovery and scoping calls with new and enterprise clients yourself. Agree what "done" looks like and keep everyone updated.
Decide what gets built. Turn messy requests from calls, Slack and email into small, clear tickets with a measure of success on each.
Build and ship production-quality code in our product. Not demos, not side forks.
Say no, or "not yet", when a request does not bring enough value, and propose the quickest version that solves the real problem.
Track the impact of your work: faster go-lives, more orders and usage on the platform, fewer support tickets, happier clients.
Work closely with Onboarding, Customer Success, Operations, Sales and the product teams.

What success looks like in your first 90 days

You have taken at least one enterprise client live, faster than our current onboarding.
You have shipped one reusable integration or workflow that more than one client uses.
You can show the numbers: time to go-live, tickets avoided, or usage gained.

Required Skills & Experience

Around 4+ years of building and shipping software that real users depend on. You code at the level of a strong product engineer and work across the stack: web apps, APIs and integrations.
You have led client calls yourself, scoped the work and pushed back when needed. Not through a product manager or account manager.
You have decided what to build, not only how to build it, and you can explain the business value with a number.
You use AI across your whole workflow, from discovery and specs to building and review. You know which tool and model you use for what, and when to check the output yourself.
Fluent English, spoken and written.

Bonus Skills

Integrations with IT, device management, identity or HR tools such as Intune, Jamf, Okta, Entra ID or an HRIS.
Experience at an agency, an early-stage startup, or running your own company, where you did a lot with a small team.
Experience with enterprise clients, and an understanding of how decisions get made (and blocked) inside large organisations.

The Right Mindset

Pragmatic and fast.
You think like an entrepreneur and care about the outcome for the client, not the ticket.
You lead yourself. Clients trust you to run their project.
You get energy from being on calls and in the room with clients, then going back to build.
You communicate clearly and directly.

ClassPass corporate membership.

Job Description:
OUR MISSION

At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes with industry leading products and platforms developed through an AI-Driven Software Development Life Cycle.

About Us

Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

CORE VALUES

One Team. One Redwood
Make Your Own Weather

YOUR IMPACT

As a Senior Backend Software Developer on the RunMyJobs (RMJ) team, you will design and deliver the services that power Redwood’s enterprise automation platform. You will shape backend architecture, build secure and reliable integrations, and improve the performance and operability of systems that support mission-critical customer workflows.

Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs using Java and the Spring ecosystem.
Contribute to distributed system architecture, including service boundaries, data flows, asynchronous processing, and fault tolerance.
Design and optimize relational data models, queries, and persistence layers for performance and integrity.
Build and maintain integrations with enterprise systems, cloud services, and external APIs.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into clear technical designs and delivered capabilities.
Own backend features through design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing improvement.
Apply secure coding practices, authentication and authorization controls, and sound API design to protect customer data and services.
Improve service reliability through observability, performance tuning, automated testing, and effective incident investigation.
Lead technical discussions, review code, and help make architectural decisions that support long-term maintainability and scale.
Mentor junior and mid-level developers and encourage practical, responsible use of AI-assisted development tools.

Your Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of professional backend software development experience, with strong expertise in Java 11/17 or later.
Strong experience with Spring Boot and building production-grade services, APIs, and microservices.
Experience designing distributed systems with a focus on scalability, resiliency, security, and maintainability.
Proficiency with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL, including schema design, SQL, and ORM technologies such as Hibernate or JPA.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience testing backend systems with tools such as JUnit and integration or API testing frameworks.
Ability to diagnose production issues, identify system bottlenecks, and implement lasting improvements.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in an agile development environment.
Experience mentoring developers and contributing to technical direction.

Essential AI-Era Skills

AI tool fluency: Experience using AI-powered development tools in a production engineering workflow.
Code judgment: Ability to review and correct AI-generated code for architectural fit, security, performance, and maintainability.
Prompting proficiency: Ability to give AI tools clear technical context to help produce useful backend code, tests, or documentation.
Adaptability and learning: Curiosity about new tools and the judgment to adopt practices that improve engineering outcomes.
Domain and architectural focus: Ability to keep business logic, service boundaries, and system integrity in view when implementing features.
Cloud-first mentality: Experience designing and deploying cloud-based services, with AWS expertise especially valuable.

Bonus Skills

Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ.
Experience building SaaS, enterprise software, or automation platforms.
Experience decomposing monolithic systems into services or contributing to broader system architecture.
Experience with Spring Security and enterprise authentication or authorization patterns.
Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab CI.
Experience with application performance profiling, JVM diagnostics, or operating-system-level troubleshooting.
Experience building AI-integrated product capabilities.
Experience with app marketplaces, platform integrations, or SAP ABAP or HANA integration.
Proficiency with shell scripting and familiarity with Gradle and Tomcat.
Contributions to open-source backend projects or a relevant GitHub portfolio.
